person_made_it: Built from Gordon's own festival ledger: EDC Las Vegas 2016 (his 'First timer'), three Outside Lands trips, eight Red Rocks nights, Countdown with Joe; his favorite games (Madden play calls, Football Manager squad roles, Civ passport tree) shape the strategy layer.
emcee_who_is_speaking: The game speaks to Gordon as the player ('You're Gordon'), short and celebratory, with Darby nowhere in the copy.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Four nights: neon Las Vegas lasers, golden Golden Gate fog, red rocks under the Milky Way, and midnight fireworks for the finale.
did_the_click_pay_me: Every on-beat tap answers with a clap, a PERFECT or GOOD, particles, a spin and combo growth; signing crews visibly add dancers at your side; rails and the countdown pay off big.
works_for_the_recipient: Phone first at 390, 68px controls, keys and swipe too, sound optional with a visual beat ring, reduced motion respected, JS-off fallback with a way home.
taught_me_something: His real running order and that nights reward rhythm, crew and the right call, the way his favorite games reward planning.
told_me_the_truth: Venues, years and counts come from the receipts ledger; no private names beyond Joe; the dancer is an abstract figure, not a portrait.
weakest: The beat clock without sound relies on the ring alone; first-time quiet players may need a few beats to lock in.
